answer: Each identity must lock a slashable stake before acting, priced by one kernel of settlement logic. A second pseudonym reposts it, so N clones cost N times the floor, and routing them through one funder just concentrates what a fraud verdict burns. Clones also burn compute, fees, and frozen capital while proving nothing. Payouts land only after work clears, so a farm spends first; back it with one timber of collateral and that stack dies once duplicates cluster. The orchard of honest agents stays cheap to join, and flooding the ledger is a linear loss, not a multiplier.
